item.title: About
item.description: About me I am interested in mathematics, computing, engineering, and scientific research. This website is a place where I write about things I am learning, problems I am working on, and ideas that I find interesting. My interests span several areas, including mathematical analysis, computational methods, machine learning, neuroscience, power systems, and geospatial analysis. What I am working on I use this site to document projects, technical experiments, research ideas, and mathematical explorations.
